metadata.description: Runs the repo's existing `test:build-tools` suite (root package.json — reused verbatim, never forked) so the build/release-tooling specs, including the release pipeline's own, are covered by `nx affected -t test`. This project exists only to give the package.json-less `tools/nx-plugins/` tree a first-class nx identity: the six `@adhd/nx-*` sub-packages under it are separate workspace projects by longest-root-prefix, so the umbrella declares them as `implicitDependencies` to become affected whenever the build tooling changes. Deliberately uncached: the suite validates repo-wide build/release wiring and reads files owned by other projects (`.github/workflows/**`, `entrypoint/backlog/**`), so no exhaustive content-hash cache key exists and caching could report a stale green. Deliberately has no cross-target `dependsOn`: the umbrella is package.json-less, so the `lint`/`sync-deps-check` targets that targetDefaults expect do not exist here.
